Card Q&A.q: If I don't delete an opponent's Digimon for this card's [Main] effect, can I use the part of the effect after "then" to have this Digimon attack?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this [Main] effect require you to pay 3 cost.
Card Q&A.q: Can I pay just 1 cost for this card's [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you don't pay 3 cost, the part after "then" in this card's [Main] effect won't let this Digimon attack.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If your opponent has a level 5 or lower Digimon, you must choose that card and delete it.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has a level 5 or lower Digimon. Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by not choosing a card to delete?

My opponent has a level 5 or lower Digimon. Can I meet the "if this effect didn't delete" condition in this card's [Main] effect by choosing an opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon with an effect that prevents deletion?

Effect: [Main] [Once Per Turn] By paying 3 cost, delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. Then, this Digimon may attack.
[On Deletion] ＜Draw 2＞ and trash 1 card in your hand.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Flame] or [CS] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
